summary: Marion County 'oakland' lookout at 775 ft on Tom Dunigan's Georgia list; no other source found for its build, status or the site today.

evidence.supports: oakland entry: Marion County, elevation 775 ft, coordinates 32.446111, -84.543056

notes_for_editor: Only one source: a single line in Tom Dunigan's list. Two WebSearch calls, the Marion County Wikipedia article and the cached Georgia lists turned up nothing else. Do not merge with us-ga-oakland (Greene County, NHLR US 704, Oconee National Forest, built 1942), which is a different tower with a different county and coordinates. The list's 'Ron topo' note is unexplained. One search result mentioned a Firetower Road address in Buena Vista, from a real-estate listing; not footnoted and not verified. Worth checking GFC records or historic USGS Buena Vista maps before publishing more than this stub.
